notes.title: ⚜️ Sword & Shield Simulator Performance and Input Update!⚜️
notes.notes:
⚔️ Hello Blacksmiths! ⚔️ 
With the upcoming patch for Sword & Shield Simulator, we're excited to announce that several of the most commonly reported issues have been addressed!🔥


One major problem that many of you experienced was related to mouse input readability. This issue should now be resolved with the latest update. However, if you still encounter any problems, please don’t hesitate to contact us—and when you do, be sure to mention the specific input device you're using, as that helps us greatly in troubleshooting. 


Additionally, if you feel that your mouse input seems delayed, we recommend checking your VSync settings. VSync is designed to reduce screen tearing, but it can introduce noticeable input lag depending on your setup.



As for performance issues: we've taken steps to improve overall game performance in this patch. If you're still experiencing difficulties, we strongly recommend switching to Performance Mode for a smoother experience.


Thank you all for your continued support and feedback—it helps us make Sword & Shield Simulator even better!

notes.title: ⚜️ Sword & Shield Simulator Demo Patch #1 ⚜️
notes.notes:
Hello Blacksmiths,
The demo is now live, and we’re actively gathering feedback and bug reports. To deliver the best experience possible, we’re listening closely!

By closely following activity in our Steam community, a few issues have been brought to our attention — and we jumped right in to fix them. 

Here's a list of the recent changes:

Proper indicator for the "Rested Camera" button while in the cart.🛞

 Sword workbench no longer disappears while designing or casting a sword. ⚒️

 Interaction with the chisel is no longer available before returning from battlefield.⚒️

 The grinding wheel pop-up window can now be closed as intended. 🔥

 Inactive player input while exiting the cart have been resolved.🛞

 Now, saving while in cart is possible. 🛞

 Proper Widget is now displayed by end of Demo📖

Improved "Performance mode", no longer heavy FPS drops are occurring. 🌠



Thank you for playing and for helping us improve!

 Play demo now!Best regards,
The S&S Simulator Team
